title: twinery-mcp-poc CLI flags
description: CLI surface for the server entrypoint after feature 006. Stdio is the default; HTTP is opt-in. The schema describes the parsed RunConfig that parseArgs() produces from process.argv.

transport.description: Selects the MCP transport. stdio retains the v0.4 default behaviour; http opts into the Streamable-HTTP transport that lets MCP clients reconnect to a long-running server URL.

host.description: Host the HTTP listener binds to. Default is loopback-only. Any non-loopback value (e.g. 0.0.0.0, a LAN IP) triggers a stderr warning at startup. Ignored when transport is stdio.

port.description: TCP port the HTTP listener binds to. 0 means OS-assigned (the resolved port is logged to stderr after listen). Ignored when transport is stdio.

exit_codes.0: Server stopped cleanly (Ctrl+C in stdio mode; SIGTERM in HTTP mode).
exit_codes.1: Server crashed (uncaught exception, unhandled rejection, or HTTP listen error such as EADDRINUSE).
exit_codes.2: Invalid CLI args. parseArgs threw before transport setup.

stderr_outputs.non_loopback_warning: [twinery-mcp-poc] WARNING: bound to <host> — reachable beyond loopback
stderr_outputs.port_in_use: [twinery-mcp-poc] port <n> is already in use. Pass --port to choose another port.

default_stdio.client_config_hint: Use the stdio command form: { command: 'node', args: ['/abs/path/to/dist/server/index.js'] }

http_auto_port.note: Server logs '[twinery-mcp-poc] http port: <n>' once the OS picks a port

tool_surface_contract.description: Tool, resource, and clarification semantics MUST be byte-equivalent across transports modulo non-determinism (timestamps, UUIDs).
verified_by: Smoke test runs the same 24 sections in both transports and compares results.
